svg.text: Cycling trip: Lama Temple to Jingshan Park
Sunday, 27 September 2026 · start 13:00 · about 11 km, four hours · shared bikes
Meet at the main gate, bikes ready.
Short stop under the old archways.
Yandai Xiejie, Silver Ingot Bridge, lake shore.
Di'anmen Dong Dajie 97. Half an hour off the bikes.
Free entry, bring your passport. Last admission 16:30.
2 yuan at the gate, then up to Wanchun Pavilion.
Shared bikes: please have your app (Meituan or
Hellobike) set up and verified before Sunday.
Park the bikes outside the park gates.
The route is a rough plan, not a race. We stop
